description: I recently joined Shana on her podcast (Episode 10. Why Not a Teacher? A Conversation with Amy Brooks) to talk about what it’s really like to run for State Delegate here in Maryland. As a high school English teacher, a mom, and your neighbor, I don’t come from a political dynasty or a wealthy background... I’m simply someone who cares deeply about our community and believes all our voices matter in Annapolis.
title: Amy Brooks on Why Not Me? Podcast
